text: Mechanical engineering is a comprehensive engineering discipline that studies the design, manufacture, operation, control, and optimization of mechanical systems. It is based on physics and mathematics, and combines materials science, computer technology, etc., to address the research and application issues ranging from macroscopic machinery (such as aircraft, machine tools) to microscopic devices (such as micro robots, precision sensors). From the steam engine of the Industrial Revolution to modern intelligent robots, mechanical engineering has always been the core force driving the transformation of human production and lifestyle.
